title: this just needs more than 4 legs to it
text:
this just needs more than 4 legs to it. I have a different brand than this and use it all the time. I trust this brand name and ordered this to try. The handle is very comfy to hold. I just wish it had more than the 4 straight arms it has. If it had 5 or 6 in an S shape, then this would have been 5 stars.

I gave this to our daughter. She did not have one. I will keep using my old one. sssshhhh don't tell her.

product_metadata.title: KitchenAid Classic Meat Masher, 10.8-Inch, Black
features: VERSATILE: ideal tool for meat, potatoes, avocados, fruit, and more
UNIQUE DESIGN: the head is comprised of 4 beveled blades that chop, mash, and stir food, and help scrape sides of pots and bowls
DURABLE: withstands everyday use and heat resistant to 450°F (252°C)
SAFE: use with all cookware, including nonstick
description: This KitchenAid Classic Multipurpose Masher is great for chopping, mashing, and stirring meat, potatoes, avocadoes, fruit, and more. The 4 beveled blades scrape the sides of bowls while mixing to thoroughly blend all ingredients. The head of the masher is heat-resistant up to 450°F and safe to use on all cookware, including nonstick. Dishwasher safe. Lifetime Limited Warranty.
